body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Denpasar, Indonesia. It starts at Jl. Imam Bonjol No.440, Pemecutan Klod, Kec. Denpasar Bar., Kota Denpasar.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Prepare for a roller coaster of enjoyment at Trans Studio Bali. Located in Indonesia's paradise island, this amusement park offers a mix of thrilling rides, attractions, and entertainment for all ages.
>
> Hold on tight as roller coasters twist and turn, and explore themed zones inspired by popular movies and TV shows. Discover fascinating realms, dream worlds, and cityscapes, all accompanied by live shows and performances.
>
> Trans Studio Bali is the perfect destination for families, thrill-seekers, and entertainment lovers alike.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €35.81. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
